---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
format: html
author: Alexa Titherington
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(shared_home = FALSE), dbdir = "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, year, rla_score) |>
  collect() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score) |>
  filter(!is.na(`2015`), !is.na(`2023`)) |>
  mutate(rla_change = `2023` - `2015`) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_change)
state_change <- tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, year, rla_score) |>
  collect() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score) |>
  filter(!is.na(`2015`), !is.na(`2023`)) |>
  mutate(
    score_2015 = `2015`,
    score_2023 = `2023`,
    score_change = score_2023 - score_2015
  ) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, score_2015, score_2023, score_change)
```

```{r}
ggplot(score_change, aes(x = rla_change, fill = rla_change > 0)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "#d95f0e", "TRUE" = "#2c7fb8"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Negative or zero", "TRUE" = "Positive"),
    name = "Change"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of District Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = paste("Districts with scores in both years:", nrow(score_change)),
    caption = "Change is the 2023 score minus the 2015 score.",
    x = "Reading score change",
    y = "Number of districts"
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 12
ggplot(
  state_change,
  aes(
    y = forcats::fct_reorder(state_name, score_2023),
    color = score_change > 0
  )
) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = score_2015, xend = score_2023, yend = state_name),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "inches")),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = score_2015), color = "gray60", size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "#d95f0e", "TRUE" = "#2c7fb8"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Decline", "TRUE" = "Improvement"),
    name = "Direction"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Scores, 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "Arrows run from the 2015 score to the 2023 score, ordered by 2023 score",
    caption = "Gray dots mark 2015 scores; arrow colors show direction of change.",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL
  )
```
